newsitem.title: USA: Weekly soy export sales highest since 1988-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Weekly soy export sales highest since 1988-USDA.

text.p: Sales of 1,163,700 tonnes of U.S. soybeans during the week ended Oct 10 were the largest weekly total in nearly eight years, U.S. Agriculture Department said Friday.
A USDA official said soybean sales were the highest since 1.22 million tonnes in the week of Nov 3, 1988.
Last week's sales total also topped the one million mark for the first time since sales of 1.15 million tonnes in the week of Oct 8, 1992.
